name: Mukhyamantri Seekho Kamao Yojana (MMSKY)
benefits: ₹8,000-₹10,000 monthly stipend for skill training in various sectors

name: Prime Minister's Internship Scheme
authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
benefits: ₹10,000 per month internship stipend for 12 months

additional_rules: Non-premier college graduates (not from IITs/IIMs/NLUs etc.)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
benefits: Free skill training with monetary rewards up to ₹10,000 per candidate

name: National Career Service (NCS) Portal
authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
benefits: Free job matching, career counseling, vocational guidance, and skill development information

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
benefits: Employers get 25% of prescribed stipend subject to max ₹1500 per month per apprentice

name: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH)
authority: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
benefits: Aggregates free and paid skill training courses from various providers

name: Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) Exams
benefits: Eligibility for various Group A, B, C, D government jobs in MP state

name: Madhya Pradesh Professional Examination Board (MPPEB) Exams
benefits: Eligibility for various subordinate services, constable, teacher, and other posts in MP

name: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) Exams
authority: Staff Selection Commission, Government of India
benefits: Eligibility for various Group B and C posts in central government ministries

name: Banking Exams (IBPS, SBI PO, RBI Grade B)
benefits: Eligibility for Probationary Officer, Clerk, and Specialist Officer positions in public sector banks
